title: Cells in Action
welcome_lead: Travel through cells doing their everyday jobs and see organisation at work.
meta_desc: KS3 Biology adventure showing how cells work together in real body parts.
final_note: You have seen how cells, tissues and organs cooperate to keep you alive.

concepts.def: Movement of particles from high to low amount.
Layer that controls movement in and out.
Sac of cell sap that keeps plants firm.
Liquid inside the vacuole of plant cells.
Similar cells together doing one task.
Tissues grouped to do a bigger job.

walkthroughs.body_html: The cell membrane is selective. It lets oxygen and food in and lets waste out by diffusion. Without it the cell could not control its contents.
A large central vacuole filled with cell sap pushes outward on the cell wall. This pressure keeps plant stems and leaves stiff and upright.
Stomach lining cells form tissue that makes acid and enzymes. The stomach (organ) churns food. The digestive system uses it to break food down.
